config_name: Aspire Lite 16" — Core 5 120U (BBY-labelled 'Ultra 5 120U'), 8GB LPDDR5, 512GB SSD, 16" WUXGA IPS

specs.cpu: Intel Core 5 120U (10-core Series 1; BBY mislabels as 'Ultra 5 120U')
specs.ports: 2x USB-C 3.2 Gen2x2 20Gbps (DP, 65W PD), 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen1 (1 power-off charging), HDMI 1.4, 3.5mm
specs.keyboard_notes: Chiclet with numeric keypad, bilingual CA

battery.notes: 58.14 Wh verified; 8GB config idles slightly lighter than 16GB twin: ~7h real.

offers.name: Acer Aspire Lite 16" Laptop - Iron (Intel Ultra 5 120U/8GB RAM/512GB SSD/Windows 11)

reviews.quote: No professional review found for this line as of 2026-11; ratings inferred from specs and sibling-line reviews.

praises: $699.99 sale for a 16" WUXGA IPS, 58Wh, 1.49 kg laptop is the standout deal of the Lite line
Battery comfortably clears a school/workday for light users
Same dual 20Gbps USB-C ports with DP + PD as the pricier Lite twin
Light enough that the 16" size doesn't punish commuting
Core 5 120U keeps Windows and Office snappy for single-task use
complaints: 8GB soldered LPDDR5 is the worst kind of dead-end: 16" productivity screen you can't feed
BBY listing calls it 'Ultra 5 120U' — no such Intel chip; buyers expecting Meteor Lake Ultra AI features are misled
With Chrome + Teams + Office open, 8GB swaps to SSD and stutters
Thin Lite chassis flexes; 720p webcam and unlit keyboard are entry-tier
Dull 45%-gamut IPS panel like every other unit in the family

standouts: Cheapest 16" WUXGA IPS + 58Wh battery combo at its $699.99 sale
dealbreakers: 8GB soldered RAM with no upgrade path on a large-screen productivity machine — the $100 16GB twin is the better buy long-term
design_philosophy: The entry RAM tier of the Lite 16: identical thin 1.49 kg 58Wh shell and Core 5 120U as the 16GB model, with 8GB soldered LPDDR5 as the cost lever. At its sale price it is one of the cheapest big screens in Canada, but the RAM ceiling caps its useful life.
rating_notes: No pro review found (see SHARED-aspire-go.md). Inferred from 16GB Lite 16 sibling: −0.8 productivity for 8GB vs 16GB, +0.2 battery for lower memory power, −0.3 creative_work. BBY 'Ultra 5 120U' label is a mislabel (no such Intel SKU) — treated as Core 5 120U; no NPU, hence ai_ml 1.5.
